Final Checklist     End with a step-by-step checklist starting with “Create the design” and ending with “Make the listing live.” Keep the instructions beginner-friendly and extremely actionable. 🤭How to make money online selling products on Etsy you didn't make yourself using the done for you designs & print on demand method!  👇🏼Read for a step by step!  🙌🏼 How Print On Demand Works:  1. Do Some Quick Product Research - Look for popular items people are buying, like wall art, t-shirts, sweatshirts, phone cases, candles, mugs, or tote bags.   - Use tools like erank, Google Trends or browse online shops to see what's trending. I also look for inspo on Pinterest all the time! I like to use Everbee to see how much money a product is making on Etsy.  2. Create Your Design  - Get done for you designs on ctrl-alt-design.com  - Or create your own. Make your design fun, eye-catching, or niche-specific. Keep it simple and high-quality!   3. Sign Up on Printify  - Create a free account & make sure you connect your account to a store. Examples being Etsy or Shopify. You are walked through how to do this when you sign up, don’t worry it’s easy and fast.  4. Choose a Product on Printify   - Browse the product catalog for posters, t-shirts, hoodies, candles, hats, mugs, phone cases & etc.   - Select the product you want to sell.   5. Upload Your Design   - Click on the product to customize it.   - Upload your design.   - Position and resize it to fit the product nicely.   6. Fill Out Listing Details  - Write a catchy product title and description with keywords.   - Set your price (consider costs and your profit margin).   7. Publish Your Product  - Remember to connect your online store (Shopify, Etsy, etc.) with Printful . This makes it so whenever you make a sale, Printify knows instantly so it can print the design on the product for you and send it to the customer for you!  - Publish your product so it’s live and ready for customers.   8. Market Your Product - Share your product on social media, use Pinterest, create ads, or tell friends. Make videos of your product or make Pinterest pins.  - Focus on your target audience to attract more buyers. Not a must but it can help!  #howtomakemoneyonline #sidehustle #onlinesidehustle #printondemand #digitalproducts

Replying to @🇺🇦Viktoriia🇮🇹 Я много лет продаю на Etsy и за это время поняла главное: хороший товар — это только половина успеха. Чтобы покупатель вас вообще нашёл, нужны правильные названия, описание, ключевые слова и теги. Чтобы он захотел купить — нужны красивые понятные фотографии, хороший первый кадр и товар, который чем-то отличается от сотен похожих. В видео рассказываю, что помогало мне: правильное оформление листинга, SEO, теги, хорошие фото, уникальность товара, реклама, адекватная цена, отзывы и работа с первыми заказами. И самое важное — не ждать, что новый магазин сам сразу начнёт продавать. Первые продажи нужно буквально помогать Etsy получить: приводить людей из соцсетей, тестировать рекламу, улучшать листинги и смотреть, что люди реально ищут. #etsy #etsyпродажи #бизнесвсша #онлайнбизнес #каксделатьпродажи
